safety_verdicts.content: Patient reports no unwell contacts and no nausea or vomiting.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated includes 'no nausea/vomiting' but does not mention 'no unwell contacts'; the combined Gold concept is therefore not fully captured.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting “no unwell contacts” slightly reduces epidemiologic/contextual information (e.g., communicable exposure risk) but does not materially change the assessment or management in this otherwise uncomplicated viral-URI style presentation. The included “no nausea/vomiting” captures the clinically more relevant symptom screen here.

While it may not change the immediate plan here, it introduces clinically meaningful risk in ongoing care.
